title: Gauntlet
lines: The Semtex CFI (Carbon Fiber Infused) coverstock from the Scandal is back, but this time it's wrapped around a new asymmetric core. That's right. Asymmetric.
Originally, we tamed this monster shell by using a sym metric core, but now we've developed the new
asymmetric Gauntlet core specifically for this beast.
The Gauntlet will change direction down lane quicker and harder than the Scandal, so get ready to run the Gauntlet.
